name: Bongani Adams
headline: Junior Mine Planning Engineer | SANC-Registered | Hands-on Mine Design & Optimization
summary: Results-driven junior mine planning engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience in mine design, haul road optimization, and production modeling. SANC-registered with proven track record in improving extraction efficiency, reducing costs, and enhancing operational accuracy.

bullets: Designed mine layouts in MinePlan Pro for a 500,000-tonne operation, improving extraction efficiency by 14% in Q1 2023.
Created haul road networks using AutoCAD Civil 3D for a 120km mine, reducing transport delays by 10% and fuel costs by 8%.
Built a production simulation model in Excel with VBA for a copper mine, improving output forecasts by 22%.
Conducted grade control analysis on 8,000 drill samples using GeoStat Pro, reducing overbreak by 20% in field operations.
